config.purpose: Quantify repeated-seed decision agreement, actual-policy prior sensitivity and label-regime error contributions from completed nested bag validation. No hidden labels, rate optimization or payload creation.
config.selection_rule: Report all strata and prior scenarios, retaining small-sample limitations. Do not infer a blind scored mask or change the frozen candidate from subgroup maxima.

interpretation: Prior scenarios are hypothetical; supplied-label regime slices do not reveal the hidden scored mask. Same outer folds have been inspected previously, so this is conditional protocol validation, not new independent model-family selection evidence.
